intro: The Pedestal Gordion table makes every meal feel open and easy. With its striking patterned top and central pedestal base, it gives six people space to dine together without clutter or compromise.

features.title: Pedestal base for free legroom
features.text: With one central support, you tuck chairs in freely and shift seats without bumping into corner legs, so you sit closer, stretch comfortably, and host with better flow around the table.

features.title: Gordion top that lights up meals
features.text: The high gloss patterned surface catches light beautifully, making breakfasts feel brighter and dinners feel special. You style flowers, candles, or serveware without the table crowding your room.

features.title: Sized right for six diners
features.text: Seat six comfortably so everyday family dinners, homework sessions, or weekend hosting flow easily. You set out platters and place settings without elbows clashing or plates fighting for space.

features.title: Stable frame you can trust
features.text: A sturdy understructure keeps the table steady as you pass dishes and pour drinks, so mealtimes feel relaxed and fuss free. The balanced design gives confidence without adding bulk to your space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
